blocks.title: How to Use
rows: The RH or Ops trainer rates the BM’s day, 9:30 AM to 7:00 PM, from the photos, videos and screenshots received in the branch WhatsApp group at each time stamp, plus a few checks in the system.
Received in the group by the "Due by" time, taken today at this branch, and every point in "Must be visible" can be seen
Up to 30 minutes late, OR one point missing or unclear (blurred, area cut off, staff member missing from a video)
Not sent, more than 30 minutes late, an old or forwarded picture, or the wrong area
Not due today (weekly items on other days, no issue or complaint that day). Left out of the score.
The time the photo or video arrives in the group is the time that counts, not the time the BM says it was taken.
Ask BMs to shoot with a time-stamp camera app showing date, time and branch on the picture, so an old photo cannot be reused. Confirm with Operations before enforcing.
Huddle and team-close clips of 30–60 seconds are enough; every attendee must appear at least once.
Each round covers five areas: reception, waiting area, washroom, corridor and one cabin between patients.
Critical items (marked C) count double. Change a weight in column F of Daily Rating if HQ decides otherwise.
Points scored ÷ points possible on the items rated that day.
GREEN at or above the green level, AMBER at or above the amber level, RED below it.
Any critical item scored 0 makes the day RED, whatever the score.
Columns AL to AN show each item’s average, its number of zeros and days rated, so repeat gaps stand out for coaching.
Day 2 holds grey example scores. Clear them before use.

blocks.title: Daily Rating
rows: BM daily practical rating · 9:30 AM to 7:00 PM
Chandigarh  ·  BM: BM name  ·  Rated by: RH / Ops trainer name  ·  November 2026

Score each item from what arrives in the branch WhatsApp group: 2 on time and complete · 1 up to 30 min late or one point missing · 0 not sent, over 30 min late, old or forwarded. C = critical: a 0 makes the day RED.
PHOTO – Clinic opening: entrance from outside
Door open, lights and signboard on, entrance and lift area clean and dry; time 9:30–9:45
Desk clear, water glass set, today’s appointment list marked; receptionist at desk in uniform with badge
Cushions squared, current-month magazines, water dispenser filled, glass and floor clean, AC on
PHOTO – Every treatment cabin (one photo each)
Fresh linen, trolley wiped, floor clean, dustbin empty, machine clean and ready; no medical stock left open
Floor dry, tissue and soap stocked, mirror clean, hourly checklist sheet on the door
Every on-duty staff member in formal attire with badge, no round-neck T-shirts; head count matches today’s roster
Present / absent by name; anyone late with arrival time and reason
Morning meetings · videos due by 10:05 AM
30–60 sec clip: BM leading, all reception staff visible; yesterday’s score, today’s appointments and VIPs mentioned
30–60 sec clip: all housekeeping staff visible; today’s standards and yesterday’s asks covered
30–60 sec clip: all counsellors visible; follow-up list and expected consults discussed
MESSAGE – Duty allocation in the WhatsApp group
Each staff member named with today’s duty
BM and doctor seated together, agenda sheet visible; MoM emailed the same day to RH, Manisha and Dr Kanikta
Today’s stock sheet next to the counted items; units (not boxes) and expiry dates; mismatch email if counts differ
Every camera live with the recording icon on and today’s time showing
Photo rounds · each due within 15 min of the round
PHOTO – 11:30 round: reception, waiting area, washroom, corridor, a cabin between patients
All five areas, taken 11:30–11:45; bins under one-third full, no open stock, floor dry
All five areas, taken 1:30–1:45; standard held after the lunch rush
All five areas, taken 3:30–3:45; waiting area reset, washroom checklist initialled
All five areas, taken 5:30–5:45; cabins reset between patients
System checks by the rater · any time before 7:00 PM
SYSTEM CHECK – 5 of today’s visits in Airtable / CRM
Correct name, mobile number, treatment, doctor, status and next appointment (needed for the 24-hour calls)
No adjustment or transfer without approval; today’s receipt checked against the delivery note
SYSTEM CHECK – Issue Tracker and emails
Today’s issues logged with owner, target date and status; emailed to the right POC with RH copied (NA if none)
Every complaint logged with next step; follow-ups and next appointments updated (NA if none)
BM with all counsellors; debrief sheet with the six questions visible
PHOTO – Cash envelope, card slip and reconciliation sheet
Sealed envelope with amount, date and BM signature; card machine settlement slip; Cash / Card / UPI vs system up to 6:30, variance explained
Hourly initials from 10 AM to 7 PM, no gaps
PHOTO – Stock room / medical storage at close
Cabinets closed, nothing open on shelves or trolleys, napkins and consumables stored
Team present; BM thanks 2–3 people by name
SCREENSHOT – BM Daily Log, BM EOD report and stock report
Three separate submissions, each time-stamped before 7:00 PM
MESSAGE – 5-line summary to RH + FDM handover note
Numbers, one story, one worry, one ask; handover note lists late patients and pending billing
After 7:00 PM · FDM, checked by the BM next morning
PHOTO – FDM closing photos and signed cash slip
Cabins reset, lights and AC off, signed slip for billing after 6:30; BM acknowledges by 9:45 next day
Weekly items due today (NA on other days)
Airtable entries with bills attached, submitted by Tuesday evening
Shared in advance, Sunday cover named
Raised in the 3rd–5th or 16th–18th window with RH approval requested
2 = on time, today, every point visible · 1 = up to 30 min late or one point missing · 0 = not sent, over 30 min late, old or forwarded · NA = not due today
Day score = points scored ÷ points possible on rated items; critical items (C) count double. Any C scored 0 makes the day RED.
Day 2 holds grey example scores; clear them before use. Sundays and days outside the month are shaded grey.
